name: maxencefaldor/bricky
title: bricky 0.1: a LEGO model compiler for coding agents, with CLI, MCP server and skill
summary: An agent writes a Python build script that places parts by BrickLink id; bricky checks the geometry, reports each mistake with the script line behind it and renders four views. Apache-2.0 on PyPI, with an MCP server (bricky-mcp) and a benchmark in the repo.
